goal: Guests and authenticated actors receive consistent navigation visibility and direct-route behavior while existing system, repository, and organization authorization contracts remain authoritative.
non_goals: Do not add roles, routes, APIs, typed fields, stores, backend middleware, persistence, dependencies, migrations, or authentication algorithms.
Do not replace dynamic repository or organization permission loading with static route metadata.
Do not change public repository or organization visibility, operations role design, node-agent policy, verified parity statuses, or complete A2.
expected_evidence: Focused real-router tests for guest, regular authenticated user, and system administrator navigation to protected routes.
Sidebar and topbar tests proving guest, user, and administrator destination visibility.
Existing repository and organization wrapper regressions proving current server permission denial, action gating, permission changes, and obsolete completion isolation.
Full frontend Vitest, formatting, lint, TypeScript, Vite build, JSON/JSONL, and diff checks.
Evidence-bearing report and independent spec and quality reviews for task-scoped A3.
unsafe_assumptions: Navigation visibility does not replace direct-route or server authorization.
Authenticated users are not automatically system administrators.
Repository and organization permissions cannot be inferred from the bootstrap user alone.
Task-local authorization tests do not complete sensory parity or task 5.5.
stop_condition: Stop if the implementation needs a new role, route, API, type, store, backend contract, persistence, dependency, migration, authentication mechanism, public-route restriction, or static inference of dynamic resource permissions.
